design.name: 雪狌狌
design.brief: A pack-hunting snow ape based on the xingxing (狌狌) of the Shan Hai Jing, an ape that knows people's names and grins like a man: a stocky, very long-armed white ape that runs on its knuckles, a pale blue face with a huge mischievous grin and tiny tusks, a jagged ridge of big faceted blue ice crystals growing out of its spine and shoulders, and one bright glowing cyan ice crystal set in its forehead (weak spot). Scraps of a frozen pilgrim's vermilion prayer cord with small bronze bells tied around one wrist. Huge hands with a clearly separate thumb and four thick fingers; feet like an ape's hands, five toes each. Cheeky, fast and annoying, dangerous in a pack.
design.weapon: no weapon: mid-leap with both huge fists raised over its head to smash the ground, a chunk of ice clutched in one fist
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized head and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted crystal shapes (never thin needles or noisy frost texture), fur as a few large carved clumps.
